D01.clause: Aplikasi RuangNota meminta izin Kamera Android. Izin kamera digunakan untuk memotret struk ketika kamu memilih Pindai Struk. Kamu tetap dapat menambahkan transaksi secara manual jika izin ditolak.

D02.clause: Aplikasi RuangNota tidak meminta izin Kamera Android. Aplikasi hanya mengambil gambar struk yang sudah dipilih dari galeri. Seluruh fitur dapat digunakan tanpa akses kamera.

D03.clause: The SuaraRapat application requests the Android microphone permission. The app uses the microphone when you tap Start Recording and stops capturing audio when you tap Stop.

D04.clause: The SuaraRapat application does not request the Android microphone permission. The app never captures audio. It accepts existing recordings only after you select them from your device.

P01.clause: We share order identifiers and your device advertising ID with our advertising partners to measure campaign performance.

P02.clause: We keep purchase receipts for 90 days and remove them automatically after that period.

P03.clause: You can request a copy of your profile and permanently delete your personal data in Account Settings.

P04.clause: We use encryption to protect your personal data in transit and at rest.
